title: Dio's Gravel Ore
description: Dio's Gravel Ore is an ore generation mod focused on adding ore to enhance exploration.
body: ## About Dio's Gravel Ore Dio's Gravel Ore is an ore generation mod focused on adding ore to enhance exploration. ## Getting Started Dio's Gravel Ore adds a variant of all vanilla ores that drops between one and four nuggets (Non-vanilla nugget added by [Dio's Extended Resources](https://github.com/AlasDiablo/Extended-Resources-NeoForge)). You can find a small quantity of those in every Overworld and Nether biomes. ### To enhance exploration, we increase ore generation in some biomes: #### Gravel Coal Ore In the Overworld you can find more gravel coal ore in Desert and Savanna biomes between height -12 and 127, This is also compatible with mods that implement the `is_desert` and `is_savanna` tags in their biomes. In the Nether you can find more gravel coal ore in Basalt Deltas #### Gravel Copper Ore In the Overworld you can find more gravel copper ore in Ocean biomes between height -12 and 60, This is also compatible with mods that implement the `is_ocean` tags in their biomes. In the Nether you can find more gravel copper ore in Crimson Forest. #### Gravel Diamond Ore In the Overworld you can find more gravel diamond ore in Jungle biomes between height -64 and 24, This is also compatible with mods that implement the `is_jungle` tags in their biomes. In the Nether you can find more gravel diamond ore in Warped Forest. #### Gravel Emerald Ore In the Overworld you can find more gravel emerald ore in Mountain biomes between height -64 and 127, This is also compatible with mods that implement the `is_mountain` tags in their biomes. #### Gravel Gold Ore In the Overworld you can find more gravel gold ore in Badlands biomes between height -48 and 127, This is also compatible with mods that implement the `is_badlands` tags in their biomes. #### Gravel Iron Ore In the Overworld you can find more gravel iron ore in Birch Forest and Mountain biomes between height -38 and 127 for Mountain and between height -64 and 52 for Birch Forest, This is also compatible with mods that implement the `is_birch_forest` and `is_mountain` tags in their biomes. In the Nether you can find more gravel iron ore in Crimson Forest. #### Gravel Lapis Lazuli Ore In the Overworld you can find more gravel lapis lazuli ore in Taiga and Dark Forest biomes between height -38 and 38, This is also compatible with mods that implement the `is_taiga` tags in their biomes. In the Nether you can find more gravel lapis lazuli ore in Soul Sand Vally. #### Gravel Redstone Ore In the Overworld you can find more gravel redstone ore in Taiga and Swamp biomes between height -38 and 42, This is also compatible with mods that implement the `is_swamp` tags in their biomes. In the Nether you can find more gravel redstone ore in Nether Wastes.
